paper_title: Feedback Friction LLMs Struggle to Fully Incorporate External Feedback
caption: Accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on the PopQA dataset as a function of o_pop frequency, measured in units of 10^4, with values ranging from 1 to 19 along the x-axis. The y-axis represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. Two distinct lines are plotted: “Initial Accuracy,” shown as a solid green line with square markers and error bars, and “Final Accuracy,” shown as a dashed blue line with circular markers and error bars. The Initial Accuracy begins at approximately 0.35 when o_pop frequency is 1×10^4, rises to a peak of ~0.5 at 5×10^4, dips to ~0.3 at 7×10^4, and then fluctuates between 0.3 and 0.5 through 19×10^4. In contrast, Final Accuracy starts at ~0.65, increases to ~0.85 at 5×10^4, dips to ~0.7 at 7×10^4, peaks again at ~0.9 at 9×10^4, and remains generally above 0.7 through 19×10^4, showing higher and more stable performance than Initial Accuracy across all o_pop frequencies.
